description: Proof / Operator Center view-model. 10 required sections (evidence_ledger, current_workspace_status, source_mutation_gates, verifier_status, rollback_status, operator_actions, programbench_provenance_status_read_only, training_eligibility_status, claim_safety_status, blocked_actions). build() refuses: (1) training_eligible_now=True -> BLOCKED_TRAINING_CONFUSION; (2) training_status_text not stating false / remains false -> BLOCKED_TRAINING_CONFUSION; (3) blocked_actions_visible=False or empty blocked_actions_text -> BLOCKED_ACTION_HIDDEN; (4) any operator_action.kind=='grant' OR any visible action without routes_to -> BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_CONFUSION (queue request is not a grant); (5) source_mutation_authorized_now=True on this view-model -> BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_CONFUSION (apply gate is authoritative); (6) programbench_provenance_read_only=False -> BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_CONFUSION.
